blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — Policemen in Lubao, Pampanga, arrested on Monday a woman who allegedly robbed and stabbed a 62-year-old market vendor in Dinalupihan, Bataan on November 6. Police arrested the 41-year-old suspect at Barangay San Pablo II, where she resides, the Central Luzon police said in a statement. “The suspect was arrested at around 10:20 a.m. in connection with the robbery-homicide that occurred on November 6 at the Dinalupihan Public Market in Barangay San Ramon, where the victim operated a ready-to-wear clothing stall,” it said.
